data.long_meaning: Guenzi is a Swiss German name derived from the Old High German word 'guot' meaning 'good' and 'hantiz' meaning 'man' or 'warrior'. The name signifies a young, brave, and good-natured individual. In Christian contexts, it can also be associated with the virtues of faith, courage, and loyalty. The name Guenzi carries the meaning “Young Warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Guenzi usually hope their child will grow to embody young warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
